speaker: Kyle
text: This forest... the air is thick with decay and old magic. Nothing natural survives here for long.

speaker: Nora
text: You're not from here. That sword on your back... you're seeking something, aren't you?

speaker: Nora
text: No illusion. Just a girl who knows the cost of loyalty. I once served the wrong side.

speaker: Nora
text: Because I know the path ahead better than you. And because... I owe them nothing anymore.

speaker: Nora
text: You’ll kill me. I know. But maybe... this time, trust won't be misplaced.
